notes: Positive: I verified the 3 substantive new tests genuinely fail against main's implementation (title '배경' instead of '붙여 넣은 생각'; 2 thoughts instead of 1; sourceId 'ours-2024-11' instead of the real uuid). The 4th is a passing regression guard. tsc clean, 162/162 vitest pass, scripts/check-version.sh consistent at 0.71.6.

web/src/lib/markdown-import.ts:145-170 The commit message claims 'A body that says `- id: `ours-2024-11`` ... used to win that search and become the thought's id' — implying it no longer can. It still can: splitExportMetadata strips backwards from the tail, so a body whose LAST line is such a bullet is swallowed into `metadata`, and exportedID's first match returns 'ours-2024-11' again. Verified: body `우리 번호` + `- id: \`ours-2024-11\`` immediately above the real metadata list restores with sourceId 'ours-2024-11'. Not a regression (main behaves the same), but the comment and commit message overstate the fix; the test at :417 only covers the arrangement where a non-matching line stops the tail scan.

web/src/lib/markdown-import.ts:102-103 The header comment says 'The exporter writes one `## ` per thought', but export_handlers.go:202 writes n.Content raw, so a thought whose pasted body contains a top-level `## ` line still splits. The change fixes `###`+ and `---` only. Worth stating as a known limit rather than 'cut where the exporter cuts it and nowhere else'.

web/src/lib/markdown-import.ts:163 thematicBreak was added to the trailing strip, so a thought whose body legitimately ends with `---` now silently loses it. Minor, and arguably unavoidable given the import screen's separator.

Scope/versioning is fine: the branch follows the repo's established pattern (Release commit for the previous branch's code, then the new code commit), and docs/releases/v0.71.6.md correctly documents 6049b70, already on main. No migration, auth, payment or workflow files touched; the change is pure frontend parsing logic and is trivially revertable.

Suggested fix direction: end export-mode cutting at the file boundary rather than at EOF — e.g. treat a thematic break that is followed by a section which is not part of an export (no `## `+metadata tail, no banner) as a return to the general rules, or track file boundaries at ImportThoughtsModal.tsx:65 instead of re-deriving them from the text.
